column11: description
Cell Ranger ARC reference directory for the dataset genome.
Exclusion dplyr filter expressions to evaluate on per-barcode metadata before initial GEX-based clustering. Expressions are parsed and evaluated in dplyr::filter().
Whether to run AMULET ATAC doublet detection for GEM wells in this dataset. TRUE enables scDblFinder::amulet().
Regex patterns to skip dataset-specific targets in custom target selections.
GEM_well_ID values for the 10x Genomics GEM wells to aggregate.
Named list of marker genes per cell type for module scoring and cluster annotation.
TSV with donor-level phenotypes and a donor_id column.
TSV mapping GEM wells to metadata with a GEM_well_ID column.
Whether to construct targets for this aggregation.
Optional aggregation-level modules to add to the target graph.
dplyr filter expressions for post-peak-calling QC. Expressions are parsed and evaluated in dplyr::filter().
Named list of TFs per cell type for chromVAR motif enrichment analysis.
Cell metadata columns for harmony batch correction. NULL skips harmony. Passed to harmony::RunHarmony(vars_use = ...).
Sequence of PC integers for GEX PCA, harmony, NN-graph, and clustering. The largest value sets BPCells::svds(k = ...) for the BPCells-native backend.
GEX PCA backend. Selects Seurat::SCTransform() or BPCells-native BPCells::sctransform_pearson() and BPCells::svds().
Metadata columns passed to Seurat::SCTransform(vars.to.regress = ...) or BPCells::regress_out(latent_data = ...).
Numeric 0-1 scDblFinder-predicted GEX doublet score cutoff to remove. 1 keeps all.
Named list mapping collapsed group names to vectors of cell type labels. NULL uses cell type labels as-is. Collapsed labels are passed to scDblFinder::scDblFinder(clusters = ...).
If TRUE clusters with tied module scores get combined labels.
Roadmap Epigenomics tissue names for chromHMM peak annotation. NULL skips chromHMM annotation.
Sequence of LSI component integers for ATAC harmony, NN-graph, and clustering. The largest value sets BPCells::svds(k = ...) for ATAC LSI.
BPCells peak counting mode. Passed to BPCells::peak_matrix(mode = ...).
Per-cluster ATAC peak caller. Selects macs3 callpeak or BPCells::call_peaks_tile().
Metadata column defining groups for peak calling and DA testing.
Additional metadata columns for ATAC-specific harmony. Appended to harmony::RunHarmony(vars_use = ...) for ATAC.
Numeric 0-1 scDblFinder-predicted ATAC doublet score cutoff to remove. 1 keeps all.
Leiden resolution for BPCells-native GEX clustering. Passed to igraph::cluster_leiden(resolution = ...).
Leiden resolution for BPCells-native ATAC clustering. Passed to igraph::cluster_leiden(resolution = ...).
Leiden resolution for BPCells-native WNN clustering. Passed to igraph::cluster_leiden(resolution = ...).
Minimum barcodes per Leiden cluster for downstream metadata.
k nearest neighbors for SNN graph construction. Passed to BPCells::knn_hnsw(k = ...).
Metadata column to split by for per-cell-type reprocessing.
Leiden resolution for clustering within subgroup analysis. Passed to igraph::cluster_leiden(resolution = ...).
Minimum nuclei required per cluster to include in subgroup analysis.
Metadata columns regressed during subgroup GEX PCA. NULL disables subgroup regression. Passed to Seurat::SCTransform(vars.to.regress = ...) or BPCells::regress_out(latent_data = ...).
Extra metadata columns for harmony in subgroup reprocessing. Appended to harmony::RunHarmony(vars_use = ...) for subgroup GEX/ATAC embeddings.
Extra categorical metadata columns for UMAP coloring and bar plots.
Extra continuous metadata columns for UMAP coloring.
k nearest neighbors for UMAP embedding. Passed to uwot::umap(n_neighbors = ...).
UMAP min_dist parameter. Passed to uwot::umap(min_dist = ...).
LSI components selected before uwot::umap() for ATAC UMAP.
PCs selected before uwot::umap() for GEX UMAP.
Additional genes to plot that are not used for cell type annotation.
Fraction threshold to discard sub-clusters with mismatched module scores. NULL keeps all.
Regex patterns to skip targets in custom target selections.
Phenotypes to plot in the differential cell type composition analysis.
Formula for differential cell type composition models. Parsed with stats::as.formula() and passed to glmmTMB::glmmTMB(formula = ...).
Optional categorical metadata column for DCTC plot coloring.
Model specification list to run pseudobulk differential analyses. Model formulas are passed to stats::model.matrix().
List of custom gene sets to use in pseudobulk analysis.
Optional Open Targets EFO or MONDO disease ID for volcano plot GWAS-evidence coloring.
Minimum pseudobulk ATAC counts per cluster-donor sample for differential TF activity.
TSV with donor-level metadata of interest. If NULL, inherits aggregation_donor_id_metadata_tsv.
Optional OLINK parquet file path.
Optional bulk RNA RDS file path.
Named Open Targets study mappings keyed by GWAS_ID.
posteriorProbability cutoff for gchromVAR. NULL applies no cutoff.
Function expression used to weight Open Targets posteriorProbability values. NULL skips weighting.
Named regex patterns used to group cell types or contrasts into plot compartments.
Degree-matched random-walk permutations per GWAS/graph branch.
Random-walk restart probability.
Maximum fraction of cells used as random-walk seeds.
